rows.ori_mechanism: Never is uninhabited and cannot be a struct field or be constructed; the type checker rejects it, so no value of an uninhabited type ever exists at runtime. Spec Clause 4.5.

Field and type alignment is computed once by ori_repr (ReprPlan) and emitted by ori_llvm; foreclosed at the type level (no raw pointers, no transmute), with the obligation to honor alignment discharged at codegen and exercised by the AOT binary tests. Spec Clause 4.5.

Channel types require T: Sendable and values use value semantics with no shared mutable state, so two threads cannot alias the same mutable location. Sendable is a compiler-derived marker. Spec Clause 4.5; 07-properties-of-types.md (Sendable).
